notes: Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/BENG-ug.html and be.ucsd.edu program page. ABET-accredited. Must maintain overall GPA >= 2.0 and earn at least C- in every course required for the major; all major courses must be taken for a letter grade. Physics 2B/2BL and 2C/2CL means the lecture plus its companion lab are both required. CHEM 7L may be taken any quarter within the first two years after CHEM 6B. Catalog also permits honors math substitutions (MATH 31BH for 20C, 31AH for 18, 31CH for 20E). Uses BOTH BENG 186A and 186B.

buckets.label: Mathematics sequence
buckets.note: MATH 18 is linear algebra; 20D/20E are differential equations / vector calculus. Honors alternatives 31BH/31AH/31CH accepted for 20C/18/20E.

buckets.label: General chemistry
buckets.note: CHEM 7L (lab) may be taken any quarter within the first two years after CHEM 6B.

buckets.label: Introductory biology
buckets.note: BILD 1 (The Cell); confirmed on program page.

buckets.label: Lower-division engineering
buckets.note: MAE 8 is MATLAB programming; MAE 40 is linear circuits; MAE 3 is engineering graphics/design.

buckets.label: Upper-division bioengineering core
buckets.note: BENG 187A-D and 188A/188B are the senior design sequence. Upper-division BENG courses are typically offered only once per year. Uses both BENG 186A and 186B.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: Two courses from the departmental approved list; must meet ABET accreditation standards and be approved before enrollment. BENG 196 and 199 may count; BENG 197 and 198 do NOT count as upper-division technical electives. Bioengineering (BE25): 8 TE units total, of which at least 4 must be the 'engineering' component. Per be.ucsd.edu/undergrad/programs/technical-electives, the ENGINEERING component = most 4-unit, upper-division (100-series) courses taken for a letter grade, NOT required for the major, taught in a Jacobs School of Engineering department (BENG, CENG chemical eng, CSE, ECE, MAE, NANO, SE structural, MATS materials science). The SCIENCE component = 4-unit upper-division (100-series) courses, not required for the major, from the Division of Biological Sciences (BILD/BIBC/BICD/BIEB/BIMM/BIPN) or the Departments of Chemistry & Biochemistry (CHEM) or Physics (PHYS). BENG 196 and BENG 199 count (two quarters of 199 can satisfy all 8 units); BENG 197 and 198 do NOT count. Ranges shown are the qualifying pools, not fixed courses.
